notes:
VP Studio is now digitally signed: the installer and every program in the suite carry a
verified "TNR Developments, LLC." signature, so Windows shows the company name at install
instead of an unknown-publisher warning.

Fixes for 150% display scaling: the Print page's record list no longer shows oversized rows,
and the Data page's field panel no longer clips or overlaps its text. On very narrow windows
the printer-status dot steps aside instead of covering the Print tab.
